Initial release of Free Video Creator AI — make and export videos using simple chat commands.

- Drag & drop up to 500MB in MP4, MOV, JPG, or PNG formats; export for free and download finished videos in 1–2 minutes.
- Designed for content creators and small businesses to bypass complex video editors.
- Friendly chat interface guides you through upload, editing, preview, and export.
